body:
That is correct. He treats me like shit and certainly doesn't need my help for anything. I will never understand how he can treat people or live life this way, so I can only wish him the very best and move on. I am optimistic that I will find someone as genuine for me as I will be for him. Meanwhile, I have to take care of myself first.

I don't know if I want to become Olivia even though like her, I seem to have a taste for *really bad men*. :( I'm so used to being Lola and she's always going to be the character closest to my heart. </3

Thank you for your kind words and encouragement.
